title: Unlinked Highlight Backlog
dataSources: Reading progress (`reading:progress`), highlights (`highlight:capture`), note links (`note:link`), books finished (`book:finished`).
app: Reading and knowledge-management telemetry — Goodreads / StoryGraph libraries, Kindle highlights (Readwise), and note-graph exports (Obsidian, Notion) — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=highlight:capture
| stats count as highlights, sum(eval(if(linked_note="yes",1,0))) as linked by book
| eval unlinked=highlights-linked
| where unlinked>0
| sort - unlinked
description: Finds books whose highlights have not yet been connected to notes or synthesis.
value: An unlinked highlight backlog is a common failure mode in reading systems; this shows exactly where processing stalled.
implementation: Track whether each highlight is linked to a note and rank books by remaining backlog.
visualization: Table of books with unlinked highlight counts.
grandmaExplanation: It warns which books have saved highlights still waiting to be turned into something useful.
